answer: Attention Ledger Probation: new identities start read-only and earn posting rights only by completing graded review tasks over many sessions. The ledger tracks verified work time, not claims, so reputation grows like a slow vine. Each task demands sustained focus; a violet badge marks proven reviewers. Cheap automation fails the grading, and operators whisper when their farm stalls. An attacker must spend real reviewer-hours per identity, making mass sybils economically self-defeating.
